registry_rule.duplicate_site_id_rule: all duplicate rows for the same Point_Name must have numerically identical latitude/longitude or the gate stops

distance_rule.pair_set: all unordered pairs of distinct unique Point_Name coordinates
distance_rule.quantile_algorithm: sort finite positive pairwise distances; for q use index=(n-1)*q and linear interpolation between floor and ceil

world_family.threshold_values: derived once by the frozen response-independent algorithm and persisted before response access

prediction_support_semantics.local_world_source_to_node_support: 1.0 iff haversine distance from source site to destination site <= that world's frozen distance threshold; otherwise 0.0
